crossRefs.note: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”

Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
